about: Central Park, next to Leomon's training spot (the characters at index 0 and 1, both at (923, 374): the floor there is flat, data/stages/330.json). Adds the Training Field guide at (955, 390) on the same flat floor, facing Leomon (dir 3: up and to the left). The guide reuses character 44 and actor image 7, the ones the stage's own characters at indexes 7 to 10 use. Talks: with the Seiryu Badge (dw3:item/9, which endEvent71 of stage 420 gives) it says its offer, plays the teleport sound and warps to the lower floor (the action "warp", docs/stages.md section 9); without it, it asks you to come back after beating the Seiryu Leader. The lines are named texts of this mod (text/<lang>/stages.json).
